summary: StarCraft franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: StarCraft
entries.definitive_edition: StarCraft: Remastered on Windows plus StarCraft 64 secondary

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Nintendo 64 emulator optional for secondary
emulation.notes: Native Windows for primary. Use original N64 hardware or accurate emulation for StarCraft 64 exclusive content.

primary.why: StarCraft released on Windows and Mac, with StarCraft 64 bringing the game to Nintendo 64 and later StarCraft: Remastered updating the PC/Mac release. Windows Remastered is the best main route because it includes modern HD presentation, Battle.net features, and the best capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use StarCraft: Remastered on Windows for the main campaign. Use StarCraft 64 only to sample its exclusive mission/tutorial content.

secondary.exclusive_content: StarCraft 64 exclusive missions/tutorial content including Resurrection IV
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the Nintendo 64 exclusive mission/tutorial content after the Windows Remastered run.
secondary.why: StarCraft 64 includes exclusive missions/content not present in the standard PC remaster, while Windows Remastered is the fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remastered preserves original gameplay with updated presentation; use original/StarCraft 64 for historical comparison and exclusive content.

entries.title: StarCraft: Brood War
entries.definitive_edition: Brood War in StarCraft: Remastered on Windows plus StarCraft 64 secondary

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Nintendo 64 emulator optional for secondary
emulation.notes: Native Windows for primary. Use original N64 hardware or accurate emulation for StarCraft 64 exclusive content.

primary.why: Brood War released for Windows and Mac, was included in StarCraft 64, and is included in StarCraft: Remastered. Windows Remastered is the best main route because it is the HD modern package for Brood War with the strongest capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use StarCraft: Remastered on Windows and play the Brood War campaigns after the base StarCraft campaigns. Use StarCraft 64 only for its exclusive mission content.

secondary.exclusive_content: StarCraft 64 exclusive secret mission Resurrection IV
secondary.what_to_play: Play Resurrection IV and any other N64-exclusive campaign content only.
secondary.why: The Nintendo 64 release contains exclusive mission content, while Windows Remastered is the best main route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use StarCraft 64 only for exclusive mission preservation.

entries.title: StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty
entries.definitive_edition: Current StarCraft II Windows client / Campaign Collection

primary.version: Current StarCraft II client / Campaign Collection
primary.why: Wings of Liberty released for Windows and Mac as the first StarCraft II campaign. Windows is the best archive route because the current StarCraft II client and Campaign Collection give the strongest capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current StarCraft II Windows client and install Wings of Liberty through the Campaign Collection or owned campaign license.

entries.remaster_caveats: Campaign Collection packaging changes access, not platform-exclusive content.

entries.title: StarCraft II: Nova Covert Ops

primary.why: Nova Covert Ops released for Windows and macOS as a standalone StarCraft II mission-pack campaign. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest capture/settings path and current client support.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current StarCraft II Windows client and install Nova Covert Ops through the Campaign Collection or owned mission-pack license.
